properties.title: Linktree

overview_description.description: Linktree provides a link-in-bio platform that combines multiple online destinations in one shareable page. Users can connect social profiles, websites, stores, and other content, then distribute the page through social platforms or QR codes. The platform also supports social media scheduling, automated replies, contact collection, digital product sales, sponsored links, appointments, and audience analytics. It serves creators, businesses, and organizations that manage content, audience engagement, and online transactions.

product.name: Social Media Management Tools

product.name: Monetization Tools
product.description: Features for selling products, courses, and digital goods, collecting commissions, hosting sponsored links, and booking paid sessions.

product.name: Analytics
product.description: Analytics tools for tracking clicks, engagement, audience activity, and conversion-related performance.
